Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified which translated author was the historian. The WebSurfer correctly reported that Bousquet translated Al-Ghazali (a theologian) and Ibn Khaldun (a Tunisian historian). The Planner incorrectly treated Al-Ghazali as the historian and concluded “Persian,” whereas the historian is Ibn Khaldun, whose heritage is Tunisian.
